book.name: Mataio
book.title: Mataio Iesu Keriso Hari Manoḡa Mataioꞌa Mirihiro

content: Ierusalema Diuḡiro
Iesuꞌa ane tahiꞌatahiꞌa teite Ierusalema hanitadu Olivi Maḡano Betefage neḡano feuriro. Ebu ane tahiꞌa aheu tuḡuzeꞌenaꞌa, ziro,
“Zama ḡoha neḡa onamoꞌi. Eꞌe neḡa diuḡine, doniki ꞌahoga batune touga ubugeta horoziꞌuma. Ebu fuhiꞌadu eḡe vaḡe zamaze aroꞌi.
Vaze ꞌahoganiꞌa ḡoere nu zoꞌidene, 'Zuhiꞌa Boroꞌa urateꞌohe,' rae noꞌi. ꞌOugine ani zogone tuḡuziꞌuma.”
ꞌOugadu Badiꞌaꞌa peroveta vazeḡanonoꞌo reiroteꞌe ḡoeꞌaniꞌa hudaro,

content.text: Aniꞌe vaḡuꞌa ebu doniki rana ehoreha.

content: Ebu Iesu tahiꞌa aheuꞌa onamadu Iesuꞌa nagini ziroteꞌe idunaḡano haḡairo.
Ze doniki ubugeta tutuze Iesu vaḡe aradu dabuaze doniki ubuga ḡarunio zahariro, ebu Iesuꞌa eꞌe rana tire ehoriro.
Vaze ḡuḡuvaḡaniꞌa dabuaze ibio hirau tiro, u vaze nuꞌe ire ezaga variꞌe madu ibi rana hiraro.
Ebu Iesu zamao onameꞌeteꞌe azaḡa zu ḡaruna hegoteꞌeteꞌe azaḡaniꞌa huaro,

content.text: Zuhiꞌa Boro niḡano areꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe ḡihiꞌa hune!

content: Iesuꞌa Ierusalema diuḡirotene, ne azaḡa niduꞌa haraeꞌenaꞌa, ḡadimutitiro, “Vaze ꞌadiꞌe iniu?”
Vaze ḡuḡuvaḡaniꞌa naenaeziro, “ꞌAdiꞌe peroveta vazeḡa Iesu, Galilea habaꞌano Nazareta neḡa vazeḡa.”
Kuru Neḡa Deheniro
Ebu Iesuꞌa kuru neḡa habaꞌa diuḡadu hoiteꞌeteꞌe azaḡa zu seroneꞌeteꞌe azaḡa hegoze buziro. Ebu hadi seniso ziniꞌeteꞌe
azaḡa fata zu Tubugo niniḡa seroneꞌeteꞌe azaḡa ehoro habaꞌa mae ḡihuniro.
Ebu aniꞌa ziro, “Buka Zaḡoḡano ꞌahige rae mirihiro, 'Badiꞌa neꞌe kuru neḡa reꞌuma.' Rehano zaeꞌa kuru neḡaꞌe ḡonore azaḡa neḡano ḡihuniro.”
Ubuma kuruḡa azaḡa ebu oda sauꞌa azaḡaniꞌa ani vaḡe kuru neḡa habaꞌa aradu aniꞌa faiziro.

Dibuꞌo vazeḡa ḡihiꞌaḡaḡihiꞌaḡa zu Mose goro ḡoeꞌa ihozeꞌeteꞌe azaḡaꞌe Iesuꞌa haḡai gigiꞌa nunu haḡairoteꞌe horoniro. Ebu tahiꞌa komeꞌakomeꞌaꞌa kuru neḡa habaꞌano huauꞌenaꞌa, “Hosana, Davida mariga!” rae reiroteꞌe igiro. ꞌOugadu ze maḡune rudaro.

Ebu ze Iesu ḡadiniro, “Ḡa tahiꞌa komeꞌakomeꞌaꞌa nagini raꞌeteꞌe igiꞌehe? Ze gararoꞌi!” Aniꞌa naenaeziro, “E igiꞌohe. Rehano zaꞌe Buka Zaḡoḡa mene meꞌodirohe? 'Badiꞌaꞌa tahiꞌa komeꞌakomeꞌa zu ene guraḡaguraḡaniꞌa ani nigunoga ihoziro.'”
Eꞌe enogano ani ze muhizadu Ierusalema ḡutuꞌaḡa onamiro ebu Betania neḡa onamadu ohere eꞌea baziro.
Figi Ireḡaniꞌa Roraro
Irarirotene, Iesuꞌa Ierusalema bare onamiro. Eꞌe ibiḡano ani vininiro.
Ebu figi ireḡa ibi genaḡano horonadu huga vaḡe onamiro. Rehano ire huga oꞌoꞌa zu rouḡa daꞌo horonadu ire eꞌe niro, “Ḡa mene bare hudaꞌuma!” ꞌOugadu ire eꞌeꞌa zogone roraro.
Ane tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌa eꞌe horonadu zaguzagaro ebu ḡadiniro, “Nougenouge figi ireḡaniꞌa ḡarihe roraneha?”

Iesuꞌa naenaeziro, “Eḡeꞌa hube hune ziꞌohe, za Badiꞌa mazao fine zu mene ꞌadaꞌadazine, eḡeꞌa figi ireḡa ꞌahi mazao haḡataꞌaꞌe zaeꞌa zuni haḡaiꞌuma. Ebu maḡa ꞌahi ninaꞌa, 'Ḡihitadu davara zamaḡano buanoꞌi,' rae reine, ꞌouge fureraꞌuma.
Zaeꞌa kurauꞌeteꞌe zamaḡano nagini umineꞌeteꞌeꞌa hugano fureraꞌuma. Zaeꞌa eꞌe mae ḡihinine, zae umino niduꞌa hidiꞌuma.”
Iesu Gigiꞌaḡa moneo Ḡadiniro
Ebu Iesuꞌa kuru neḡa diuḡadu vaze ihozirotene, dibuꞌo vazeḡa ḡihiꞌaḡaḡihiꞌaḡa zu vaze boroboroꞌa ani vaḡe aradu ḡadiniro, “Ḡa noꞌe gigiꞌaḡa hina ꞌahiguḡa haḡaeꞌohe? Iniuꞌa ꞌahi gigiꞌaḡa ḡaniro?”
Iesuꞌa naenaeziro, “Eḡe zuni ḡadimu ꞌahoga zinihi. Zaeꞌa naenaehine, eḡe zuni noꞌe gigiꞌaḡa hina ꞌahiguḡa haḡaeꞌeteꞌe ihoziꞌuma.

Ioaneꞌa babatiso zinirotaꞌaꞌe noumanoꞌo? Badiꞌa mazaonoꞌo ga vaze mazaonoꞌo?” Ze zeḡeꞌa bare ḡoꞌaneꞌenaꞌa, ḡadimutitiro, “Badiꞌa mazaonoꞌo reine, 'Za nougadu Ioane ḡoere mene mae ḡihiniro?' rae ifiꞌuma.
Rehano vaze mazaonoꞌo reine, eme vaze rihozeꞌohe, mazaḡa zeḡe niduꞌa Ioaneꞌe hube hune peroveta vazeḡa rae mae ḡihineꞌohe.”
Eꞌanoꞌo ze ꞌahige naenaeniro, “Emeꞌe aḡuꞌa.” Ebu Iesuꞌa ziro, “Eḡe zuni noꞌe gigiꞌaḡa hina haḡai ꞌahiguḡa haḡaeꞌeteꞌe mene ihoziꞌuma.”
Ubuga Aheu Hari Idaidaḡa

Iesuꞌa dibuꞌo vazeḡa ḡihiꞌaḡaḡihiꞌaḡa zu vaze boroboro mazao hari idaidaḡa ꞌahoga ziro, “Za hari idaidaḡa ꞌahi zamaroꞌi. Vaze ꞌahoganiꞌa ubuga aheu teite radiunu. Aniꞌa ubuga ibiꞌa vaḡe onamadu niro, 'Eḡe tahiꞌa, ḡa izidi vaini mebaḡano gaui onamoꞌi.'
Ebu ubuganiꞌa naenaeniro, 'E mene onamiꞌuma.' Rehano ani vesuꞌu zamaḡa ḡihunadu onamiro.
Ebu moganiꞌa ubuga veḡa vaḡe onamadu ubuga ibiꞌa niroteꞌe ḡoeꞌa idaḡa niro. Aniꞌa Moga niro, 'E onamiꞌuma.' Rehano ani mene onamiro.

Zaꞌa zamareꞌetene, ubuga aheu boꞌaḡano iniuꞌa moga ura haḡairo?” Zeḡeꞌa naenaeniro, “Ubuga ibiꞌa.” Ebu Iesuꞌa ziro, “Eḡeꞌa hube hune ziꞌohe, takesi azaḡa zu daro fuꞌa roḡaeḡaroḡaeḡaꞌe Badiꞌaꞌa zuhiꞌaziꞌeteꞌe zamaḡano ibite diuḡiꞌuma. Zeḡeꞌa zae vitiziꞌuma.

Ioane Babatisoꞌe ibi duduḡa ihozoga radu zae vaḡe ariro, rehano za mene mae ḡihiniro. U takesi azaḡa zu daro fuꞌa roḡaeḡaroḡaeḡaꞌe ani ḡoere mae ḡihiniro. Za zeḡeꞌa ꞌouge haḡairoteꞌe horoniro rehano, mene ḡihuradu ani mene mae ḡihiniro.”
Hihi Azaḡa Sauꞌa Hari Idaidaḡa

Iesuꞌa bare ziro, “Hari idaidaḡa ꞌahoga egoꞌi. Haba vazeḡa ꞌahoganiꞌa radiunu. Aniꞌa vaini mebaḡa ḡoranadu ḡabiꞌa merau varahiro, ebu vaini maḡa vuḡa gigeꞌeteꞌe veize iduḡa ꞌahoga huꞌiro, zu ehamuꞌeteꞌe neḡa hitaga haḡairo. Hena vaini mebaḡa eꞌe hihi azaḡa nu ꞌevoreo tiro, ebu aniꞌe haba ꞌahoga onamadu mada faḡa ragavinu.
Hiriveꞌeteꞌe madaḡaniꞌa hanitirotene, vaini maḡa nu mouga radu aniꞌa ane tuḡure azaḡaꞌe hihi azaḡa vaḡe tuḡuze onamiro.
Rehano zeḡeꞌa tuḡure azaḡa oboze teadu tibaꞌe bouniro, ꞌahogaꞌe maro ebu ꞌahogaꞌe hadi hina mau bohiniro.
Hena haba vazeḡaniꞌa tuḡureḡa azaḡa ibiꞌa vitine ufeta ḡehaḡa zeḡe vaḡe bare tuḡuziro, rehano ze tuḡure azaḡa eꞌe mazao haḡai tiba eꞌe bare haḡairo.
Ḡonagano aniꞌa ubuga zeḡe vaḡe tuḡunadu ꞌahige rae reiro, 'Ze eḡe ubude gubaniꞌuma gaogi.'
Rehano hihi azaḡaniꞌa ubuga horonirotene, zeḡeꞌa neneḡaniro, 'Aniꞌe moga mazaonoꞌo vaini mebaḡa ꞌadi meiteꞌe vazeḡa. Eme ani matihi ebu vaini mebaḡa ꞌadi emeḡeꞌa meihi.'
Eꞌanoꞌo zeꞌa ani obone teadu vaini mebaḡanonoꞌo ani uhine bunadu mau runiro.”
Ebu Iesuꞌa dibuꞌo vazeḡa ḡihiꞌaḡaḡihiꞌaḡa zu vaze boroboro ḡadiziro, “ꞌOugadu vaini mebaḡa vazeḡaꞌe hihi azaḡa eꞌe vaḡe arine, zeḡe mazao nougiꞌuma?”
Zeḡeꞌa naenaeniro, “Aniꞌa hihi azaḡa eꞌe mau ruziꞌuma. Ebu vaini mebaḡaꞌe hihi azaḡa ꞌahoga nu ziniꞌuma. ꞌOugine, hiriveꞌeteꞌe madaḡano zeḡeꞌa ani huga nu haꞌuma.”
Iesuꞌa ziro, “Zaꞌe Buka Zaḡoḡano ḡoere ꞌahi mene meꞌodirohe?

content.text: 'Vazeꞌa hadi hina ne ogorarotene, zeꞌa mae modiroteꞌe hadiḡaꞌe ne duꞌe rinedeꞌeteꞌe hadiḡa reiro.
Aꞌe Zuhiꞌa Boroꞌa haḡairoteꞌe haḡaiḡa. Emeḡeꞌa ḡianadu zaguzagauꞌohe.'

content: Eꞌanoꞌo eḡeꞌa ziꞌohe, Badiꞌaꞌa za, Isaraela azaḡa mene bare zuhiꞌaziꞌuma, rehano haba ꞌahoga azaḡa ane ura haḡaeꞌetaꞌaꞌe zuhiꞌaziꞌuma.
Iniuꞌa hadi eꞌe rana higaune, ani varadu tahitahiꞌuma zu hadi eꞌeꞌa iniu rana higaune, aniꞌe seꞌetiꞌuma.”
Dibuꞌo vazeḡa ḡihiꞌaḡihiꞌaḡa zu Farisea azaḡaniꞌa Iesu hari idaidaḡa igirotene, Iesuꞌa zeḡe moneo reirotaꞌaꞌe ederiro.
ꞌOugadu zeꞌe Iesu obone tihi reiro. Rehano vaze ḡuḡuvaḡaniꞌa zeḡe mazao maḡuniꞌuma radu rihoziro, mazaḡa vaze ḡuḡuvaḡaniꞌa Iesuꞌe peroveta vazeḡa rae mae ḡihiniro.
